name: tech-leadership
description: Plugins for the tech-lead side of engineering -- 1:1s, delegation, tech debt prioritization, incident/postmortem writing, stakeholder communication, design doc review. Content is authored once per plugin under plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md and adapted for Claude, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, and OpenAI Codex CLI -- see adapters/.

plugins.name: _template-plugin
plugins.description: TEMPLATE -- not a real plugin. Scaffolding used to validate the marketplace structure and all four tool adapters end to end. Copy this directory when starting a new plugin; don't install it as-is.

plugins.name: one-on-one-prep
plugins.description: Prepares for 1:1s with direct reports by pulling recent PR/ticket activity and prior 1:1 history into talking points that go beyond status updates, then logs what was discussed and tracks follow-ups and themes over time.

plugins.name: tech-debt-prioritizer
plugins.description: Ranks technical debt by business impact rather than by how unpleasant the code is -- scoring blast radius, velocity drag, customer impact, cost of delay, and effort into a tiered Now/Next/Later list, then keeping a team-visible register and reporting on what actually gets paid down.

plugins.name: delegation-assistant
plugins.description: Breaks a project into chunks and matches each one to a team member on purpose -- by stated skill level, growth fit, and current workload -- instead of defaulting to whoever is most senior or most available. Keeps a roster, flags chunks nobody is ready for, and tracks how assignments actually went.

plugins.name: incident-postmortem-writer
plugins.description: Structures a blameless postmortem fast while details are still fresh -- capturing an incident timeline live, turning it into a full postmortem whose root causes are framed as system and process gaps rather than individual mistakes, and tracking recurring causes and never-closed action items across incidents.

plugins.name: stakeholder-translator
plugins.description: Rewrites a technical update -- a PR summary, an incident, an architecture decision, a sprint status -- for a specific non-technical audience, reframing it around business impact, risk, timeline, and cost without letting severity, uncertainty, or real caveats get smoothed away in the process. Keeps a profile of what each stakeholder cares about and a record of what they have already been told.

plugins.name: design-doc-reviewer
plugins.description: Checks a design doc for structural and completeness gaps before it goes to the team -- whether the problem statement is clear, real alternatives were weighed, failure modes and blast radius are addressed, rollout and rollback are planned, and ownership is named. Produces a findings table with draft questions to raise, not a line edit, and tracks which gaps keep recurring across a team's docs.
